bands.varieties: SC 555, SC 529, MH 26 or Falcon M601

tasks.label: Deep ploughing (20-30 cm)
tasks.detail: Deep ploughing (20-30 cm). Incorporate 5-10 mt/Ha manure into ridges before rains.

tasks.label: Apply basal fertiliser
tasks.detail: Sow certified seed at 3-5cm depth within 48 hours of first effective rain (30mm+). Space 75x25cm. Apply basal NPK.

tasks.label: Scout the crop
tasks.detail: Scout rows daily for uniform germination. Check for soil crusting or early insects.

tasks.label: Execute precision gap-filling
tasks.detail: Execute precision gap-filling. Re-sow empty stations with the exact same variety.

tasks.label: First weeding
tasks.detail: Perform 1st thorough weeding. Apply first split of Nitrogen top-dressing (Urea/AN) at 100 kg/Ha.

tasks.label: Top-dress with nitrogen
tasks.detail: Perform 1st thorough weeding. Apply first split of Nitrogen top-dressing (Urea/AN) at 100 kg/Ha.

tasks.label: Second weeding
tasks.detail: Perform 2nd mechanical weeding. Complete 'earthing up' (mounding loose soil high around stalk base).

tasks.label: Top-dress with nitrogen
tasks.detail: Apply the second split of Nitrogen top-dressing (Urea/AN) at 100 kg/Ha right before a rain event.

tasks.label: Scout the crop
tasks.detail: Scout for Fall Armyworm daily. Monitor moisture. Peak vegetative demand.

tasks.label: Third weeding
tasks.detail: Protect fields from late weeds or lodging. Keep leaves functional and green.

tasks.label: Harvest
tasks.detail: Verify black layer formation at kernel base. Harvest immediately to avoid field exposure.

tasks.label: Dry and store
tasks.detail: Sun-dry cobs on clean tarpaulins to 13.5% moisture. Shell carefully. Treat with Actellic dust. Store in Hermetic bags.

tasks.label: Land Preparation
tasks.detail: Land Preparation: Ploughing/ridging (spaced at 75cm or 60cm). Procure certified seed and active Rhizobium inoculant. Keep inoculant cool.

tasks.label: Sowing & Inoculation
tasks.detail: Sowing & Inoculation: Mix seed with inoculant wet-slurry using sugar water. Plant immediately into damp soil at 2-3cm depth. Spacing: 5-7cm apart.

tasks.label: First weeding
tasks.detail: Pre-Emergence Weed Shield: Apply pre-emergence herbicide mixtures to wet soil immediately before any seedlings break the surface.

tasks.label: Scout the crop
tasks.detail: Germination Scouting: Monitor field for even emergence. Check for soil capping or early insect damage like cutworms.

tasks.label: Second weeding
tasks.detail: Early Weeding & Post-Emergence: Complete the first weeding round. Spray post-emergence herbicides for broadleaf weeds if needed.

tasks.label: Third weeding
tasks.detail: Nodulation Check & 2nd Clean: Dig up a few plants to check root nodules. If pink inside, nitrogen fixing is active. Complete 2nd weeding.

tasks.label: Top-dress with nitrogen
tasks.detail: Nodulation Check & 2nd Clean: Dig up a few plants to check root nodules. If pink inside, nitrogen fixing is active. Complete 2nd weeding.

tasks.label: Scout the crop
tasks.detail: Flowering & Pod Initiation: Peak water and nutrient uptake phase. Monitor closely for early signs of Asian Soybean Rust fungus.

tasks.label: Scout the crop
tasks.detail: Pod Filling Phase: Grains expand inside the pods. Scout for pod-sucking bugs and leaf-eating caterpillars.

tasks.label: Physiological Maturity
tasks.detail: Physiological Maturity: Leaves turn yellow and drop off naturally. Pods turn brown and rattle when shaken.

tasks.label: Dry and store
tasks.detail: Handling & Storage: Thresh on clean canvas tarpaulins. Dry grain to 12% moisture. Store in dry, clean, hermetic bags away from pests.

tasks.label: Scout the crop
tasks.detail: Handling & Storage: Thresh on clean canvas tarpaulins. Dry grain to 12% moisture. Store in dry, clean, hermetic bags away from pests.

bands.varieties: CG 7, CG 9, CG 11, Nsinjiro or Baka

tasks.label: Land Preparation
tasks.detail: Land Preparation: Construct precise contour ridges spaced 75cm apart. Sieve and prepare certified shell-on seeds.

tasks.label: Sowing
tasks.detail: Sowing: Plant immediately after 30mm+ rain. Plant 2 rows per ridge (double-row), 10-15cm between seeds, 5cm deep.

tasks.label: Emergence Monitoring
tasks.detail: Emergence Monitoring: Inspect fields daily for standard germination rate (expecting 85%+ standalone rate).

tasks.label: Gap Filling
tasks.detail: Gap Filling: Re-sow missing pockets immediately using the same variety; avoid deep soil disturbance.

tasks.label: First weeding
tasks.detail: First Weeding: Hand weed cleanly. Groundnuts are extremely sensitive to early weed shading and choking.

tasks.label: Second weeding
tasks.detail: Second Weeding & Earthing Up: Final light weeding. Reshape ridges carefully before flowering starts.

tasks.label: Apply gypsum
tasks.detail: Gypsum Application (Flowering): Apply Calcium Sulfate (Gypsum) at 200-400 kg/Ha directly over rows/plants.

tasks.label: Third weeding
tasks.detail: Strict No-Disturbance Window (Pegging): DO NOT weed or enter fields. Let pegs naturally penetrate soil.

tasks.label: Scout the crop
tasks.detail: Disease & Pest Scouting: Monitor for Leaf Spots and Rosette Virus (transmitted by aphids). Spray if needed.

tasks.label: Harvest
tasks.detail: Maturity & Lifting: Check inner pod color (dark brown/black markings = mature). Lift plants carefully with a hoe.

tasks.label: Dry and store
tasks.detail: Plucking, Drying & Curing: Invert plants to sun-dry pods for 2-3 weeks (pod moisture <10%). Clean, shell by hand, store.

tasks.label: Select lowland plot (Dambo)
tasks.detail: Select lowland plot (Dambo). Clear stubble.

tasks.label: Construct flat nursery beds near water source
tasks.detail: Construct flat nursery beds near water source. Sow nursery seeds.

tasks.label: Plough main field heavily to create muddy clods
tasks.detail: Plough main field heavily to create muddy clods. Build field bunds.

tasks.label: Wet field to saturation
tasks.detail: Wet field to saturation. Broadcast seeds directly or pull seedlings.

tasks.label: Check the water
tasks.detail: Monitor germination/transplant shock. Keep soil moist.

tasks.label: First weeding
tasks.detail: Execute early hand weeding. Repair bund leaks.

tasks.label: Apply basal fertiliser
tasks.detail: Apply Basal Fertilizer (Compound D) at 100 kg/Ha if water level is low.

tasks.label: Maintain thin water layer (2-3 cm)
tasks.detail: Maintain thin water layer (2-3 cm). Fill missing gaps.

tasks.label: Second weeding
tasks.detail: First split Top-Dressing (Urea at 75 kg/Ha). Hand weed.

tasks.label: Top-dress with nitrogen
tasks.detail: First split Top-Dressing (Urea at 75 kg/Ha). Hand weed.

tasks.label: Top-dress with nitrogen
tasks.detail: Second split Top-Dressing (Urea at 75 kg/Ha). Monitor pests.

tasks.label: Scout the crop
tasks.detail: Second split Top-Dressing (Urea at 75 kg/Ha). Monitor pests.

tasks.label: Scout the crop
tasks.detail: Scout for Stem Borers & Blast disease. Maintain water level.

tasks.label: Protect field from birds
tasks.detail: Protect field from birds. Keep water at 5-10 cm depth.

tasks.label: Harvest
tasks.detail: Drain field completely 2 weeks before target harvest date.

tasks.label: Harvest
tasks.detail: Harvest when 80% of panicles turn straw-colored. Avoid dropping in mud.

tasks.label: Dry and store
tasks.detail: Thresh on clean tarpaulins. Sun-dry grain to 13.0% moisture.

bands.varieties: Kutsaga T71, KM10 or Burley BRK

tasks.label: First weeding
tasks.detail: Nursery site selection & soil sterilization via burning wood/stalks to kill weed seeds and nematodes.

tasks.label: Apply basal fertiliser
tasks.detail: Construct nursery beds (1m wide). Apply basal compound S fertilizer to beds. Prepare shade structures.

tasks.label: Top-dress with nitrogen
tasks.detail: Sow tiny tobacco seeds uniformly using water-can mix. Cover immediately with fine grass thatch.

tasks.label: Water nursery twice daily
tasks.detail: Water nursery twice daily. Thin seedlings to 2cm spacing at Day 15. Clip leaves at Day 30 to harden stems.

tasks.label: Transplant out to main field when seedlings are pencil-thick (15-20cm) i
tasks.detail: Transplant out to main field when seedlings are pencil-thick (15-20cm) immediately after 30mm+ rain.

tasks.label: Apply basal fertiliser
tasks.detail: Scout for cutworms. Apply basal fertilizer (Compound D/Tobacco mix) at 15g per plant station.

tasks.label: Scout the crop
tasks.detail: Scout for cutworms. Apply basal fertilizer (Compound D/Tobacco mix) at 15g per plant station.

tasks.label: Second weeding
tasks.detail: First mechanical weeding using hand hoes. Re-ridge plants to establish strong root anchorage.

tasks.label: Third weeding
tasks.detail: Apply top-dressing fertilizer (Calcium Ammonium Nitrate - CAN). Maintain absolute weed-free fields.

tasks.label: Top-dress with nitrogen
tasks.detail: Apply top-dressing fertilizer (Calcium Ammonium Nitrate - CAN). Maintain absolute weed-free fields.

tasks.label: Scout the crop
tasks.detail: Scout for Wildfire, Angular Leaf Spot, and Aphids. Apply recommended fungicides/insecticides.

tasks.label: Inflorescence appears
tasks.detail: Inflorescence appears. Top the plants (remove flower heads) to redirect nutrients to the leaves.

tasks.label: Suckering management
tasks.detail: Suckering management: Manually break off suckers from leaf axils weekly or apply sucker oil.

tasks.label: Harvest
tasks.detail: Harvesting by reaping leaves as they ripen (turning yellow-green). Move immediately to curing barns.
